gate.CLEAR_TEXT: no parsed tool call AND no deterministic recovery trigger
gate.CLEAR_EXECUTE: parsed local tool call, EXCLUDING prose-document (isProseDocument) and reply-only cases
gate.boundary: produceToolPath() semantics: parseToolCalls, confabulation/hallucinated-completion/remote-artifact detection, isProseDocument, reply-only handling

arbitration.VERIFY: verifier EXECUTE -> EXECUTE; verifier TEXT -> TEXT; verifier UNCERTAIN/invalid/error -> UNCERTAIN
